finding.summary: The add-plan stop was caused by page markup. Education and career rows (div.repeat-row) and their add buttons were flat children of <form> with no group container, so the generic collector could not attribute any row to either add action: currentGroupCount was 0 although the page had 4 education and 3 career rows. The career plan then needed 1 addition, the inert button did not add a row, and the executor stopped with group-count-not-incremented.
finding.reproduction: frontend/fixtures/generic-baseline/run-baseline.mjs --diagnose against the pre-fix page (PR #228 version), provider jev, 1 run: preparation returned 2 ADD_REPEATABLE_GROUP plans; diagnosis recomputed with the production collectPreparationSnapshot/localItemCount right after the preparation response.
finding.before_fix_outcome: EXCEPTION group-count-not-incremented (추가 동작의 반영을 확인하지 못했습니다), 0 field analysis requests
finding.after_fix_outcome: RESULT, requiredAdditions 0 for both plans, field analysis requested
